attributes.name: head meta tag set
attributes.definition: Which meta tags and head elements the page's head contains.

values.definition: Only charset, viewport and description meta tags (plus title).
Includes additional meta such as social/Open Graph, robots, canonical, etc.
Does not fit or not present.

attributes.name: document title style
attributes.definition: Treatment of the page title text in the head.

values.definition: Title uses separators, symbols or emoji.

attributes.name: h1 and heading outline
attributes.definition: Presence of an h1 and depth of the heading hierarchy.

attributes.name: list items as headings
attributes.definition: Whether list entries are marked up as headings.

values.definition: List entries are plain list items, not headings.
